description: Curated one-tap multi-watch bundles. Adding a vertical is data: append a template with id, audience description, and watches [{lens, filter}] that the existing /subscribe path can replay. English title/description live here for the public surface; i18n keys are optional overrides.
source: Editorial product registry for association monitor packs. Agency names match City Record Online section Agency Rules values (e.g. Health and Mental Hygiene, Taxi and Limousine Commission, Buildings, Administration for Children's Services). Keywords are product-curated full-text seeds, not a publisher table dump.

templates.title: Restaurant & food-service rules
templates.description: Health-code and food-service rule changes from the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene, plus keyword matches for restaurant and food-service language in Agency Rules.
templates.serves: Restaurant operators, hospitality associations, and food-service managers tracking DOHMH health-code and food-service rules.

templates.title: For-hire vehicles (TLC)
templates.description: Rule changes from the Taxi and Limousine Commission, plus keyword coverage for for-hire vehicle, medallion, and driver rules.
templates.serves: For-hire vehicle fleets, TLC licensee associations, and driver-service organizations.

templates.title: Construction safety (Buildings)
templates.description: Department of Buildings rule changes and construction-safety keyword matches across Agency Rules.
templates.serves: General contractors, construction trade associations, and site-safety managers following DOB rules.

templates.title: Child care (ACS / DOHMH)
templates.description: Child-care and early-childhood rule changes from the Administration for Children's Services and the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene.
templates.serves: Child-care providers, early-childhood associations, and parent-organization staff tracking ACS and DOHMH child-care rules.
